notes: 8 configurations of 8 models from 6 manufacturers (Oxford Instruments NanoScience, Lake Shore Cryotronics, ICEoxford, Advanced Research Systems, kiutra, Bluefors), none duplicating data/cryostats (the catalog has the Oxford OptistatDry, Lake Shore CRX/CPX/Janis CCS probe-station and Bluefors LD dilution refrigerator, which are different machines). Categories covered: LN2 detector/CCD cryostats (OptistatDN-V, VPF-100), closed-cycle detector/receiver cryostats (DRY ICE 3K INV, Bluefors LD-4K), large cold-plate cryostat for arrays and cold optics (CCS-CP), He-3 sorption for TES/KID (DRY ICE 300mK Benchtop), ADR for MKID/microcalorimeters (kiutra L-Type Rapid 3P55) and a True-UHV cold head for laboratory ice astrochemistry (ARS CS204AB). Accessed 2026-11-01; all values are manufacturer specifications quoted from datasheets, manuals and spec pages (PDF text extracted in reading order; quotes keep the printed label-value text with whitespace collapsed). Conservative choices: "<3K", "<4 K", "<10K" range bounds stored as 3/4/10 K; kiutra "(expected)" values stored at the guaranteed bound; ARS cooling powers/cooldown at 50 Hz; worst stated stability where stability varies with temperature; VPF-100 range limited to 77-500 K because the 65 K pumping manifold is not in the configuration. Absences: magnet not_available for OptistatDN-V (manual component list), VPF-100 and CCS-CP (complete 7-step configurators offer no magnet), DRY ICE 3K INV (spec table "Magnetic Field N/A"), ARS CS204AB (typical configuration and options list). Options present but not fitted are optional_not_installed (windows, magnets, magnetic shielding, Bluefors wiring). Configurations that include an offered wiring option (VPF-100 wired feedthrough, CCS-CP 100 DC wires + 67 GHz RF, DRY ICE 3K INV wiring kit, DRY ICE 300mK customer DC loom, kiutra 12 RF lines) say so in configuration_basis. ARS pressure.base 1e-11 Torr is the cold-head UHV rating; the vacuum chamber is customer-supplied. Gaps (see not_found): kiutra and Bluefors LD-4K publish no maximum temperature or vacuum statement, several cryostats publish no vacuum level or sample height. The OptistatDN-V pressure.base uses the manual pump-down requirement (<1e-4 mbar) and VPF-100 uses the stated initial vacuum requirement (~1e-3 Torr at room temperature). Tavily search quota was exhausted and the WebSearch budget ran out during research, so candidate machines (e.g. Oxford Instruments Heliox/Proteox, FormFactor/Entropy ADRs, Sumitomo/Cryomech stand-alone cryocoolers, IRLabs custom dewars) could not be examined further.
